title: Last song. Part 5
note: Silent. Frame 1 fully composed: ONE strip (hook), two large faces, his phone lit mid-swipe (bigger), her big tent card (dance?), dance floor lit behind with DJ sign LAST SONG, aunt with clipboard small. He flips the phone at ~1.7 and freezes at the card. Take 1 (i'll watch your bag.): she goes to the floor, the whole room does a conga (even the aunt with her clipboard), he sits alone at table 9 hugging her sequined bag in a spotlight: I became the bag guy. Lazy Susan back, rewind. take 2. Take 2 (i can't. teach me?): she laughs, draws two footprints on the back of a place card + (stand here.). On the floor he steps on her toe (squash, wince-laugh), his jacket pocket buzzes (phone glow + buzz lines) and he ignores it, they sway under string lights, music drops out. Cliff: house lights up, aunt waves car keys (car's here!), she slides the LAST blank card to him. Vote A (MY NAME. / YOURS?) / B (SAME TABLE / NEXT WEDDING?). End card part 6. No NoSwipe mention.

hooks.a: the stranger beside me at this wedding asked me to dance.
hooks.b: the girl I like asked me to dance. I can't dance.

choices.question: she's leaving. one card left. what do I write?
choices.why: Both about him; neither mocks her. Part 6 plays the winner.

strips.text: take 1. I wrote on my card:
she laughed. drew me a map.
my phone buzzed. I ignored it.
I can't dance. we danced anyway.
she's leaving. one card left. what do I write?
